text: {"headline":"EU refund amount rose from $20 to $260 between June and July 2026, a $240 increase, while order counts stayed flat at 4 orders each month.","summary":"EU refunds increased sharply from a single $20 size_issue refund in June to three refunds totaling $260 in July, mostly attributed to shipping_delay. This is an association based on reason codes, not a verified cause, and the sample is extremely small—only 4 refunds across 8 total orders—so the shift may not be statistically meaningful. The data does not establish why shipping delays occurred or confirm that they truly drove the refunds.","contradictions":["Evaluator flagged that the sample size (4 refund records) is too small to treat the $240 increase as statistically meaningful.","Evaluator noted the increase reflects both more refunds and higher average refund size (~$87 vs $20), a distinction the SQL Analyst summary did not separate.","Evaluator cautioned that 'shipping_delay' is a stated reason code, not a confirmed root cause, so the 'why' remains unresolved.","Evaluator observed a 100% refund rate per order with a reason, suggesting full-order refunds, which needs confirmation and was not addressed in the SQL Analyst summary."]}
